description: Shared conformance corpus for site-identity normalization. A byte-identical copy lives at mysticat-data-service/scripts/serenity_migration/fixtures/site_identity_corpus.json. Both suites assert the sha256 of their own copy against a pinned constant, so editing one without the other fails loudly. The two implementations write and compare the same Semrush field, so any disagreement makes a reconcile rewrite a value the other side just wrote correctly. Internationalized hosts and non-ASCII paths are included deliberately: Node's WHATWG URL punycodes and percent-encodes them, and the Python half is written to match rather than to sidestep the case.
